text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up for anyone who uses the Berlin hub: the building will be closed for a phased floor renovation Mon-Wed, June 14-16. We're arranging alternatives and travel support.

Noah (People Ops): TL;DR: Hub closed 14-16 Jun. Coworking passes available + one-night hotel stipend for colleagues traveling >90km. RSVP form: internal link.

Elias (Facilities): Renovation scope: carpets replaced, HVAC upgrades, and ceiling work on floors 3-6. Noise and access interruptions start 8am Monday. Security/lobby stays open but access to desks on affected floors will be blocked.

Hana (Eng): If I'm booked for an interview loop on Tuesday, what happens?

Maya (People Ops): @Hana we will move interviews to virtual by default. If a candidate must be in person, we'll schedule at a coworking site or book a private meeting room at our partner space. Please ping people-ops with candidate names.

Noah (People Ops): Coworking options (book through the form):
- WeWork Potsdamer Platz (company rate)
- Betahaus Kreuzberg (day passes)
- Satellite hub (limited capacity)

TransitBot: Public transit alert: S-Bahn disruptions expected Mon-Wed morning due to separate works. Allow +20min.

Elias (Facilities): For teammates traveling from other cities: we will cover one night hotel up to EUR 120 if your commute exceeds 90km each way. Submit receipts within 14 days.

Hana (Eng): Do we get a daily meal per diem if on-site coworking?

Maya (People Ops): Yes 0 EUR/day meal stipend for days in coworking when the hub is closed. Add "Berlin renovation" as Expense Note.

Noah (People Ops): Expense example to paste into the form:
```
Expense: Hotel
Amount: EUR 98.00
Date: 2026-06-14
Category: Travel - Hub Renovation
Notes: One-night hotel stipend - Berlin hub renovation
```

Elias (Facilities): Equipment lockers: if you need to drop a spare monitor or docking station, we'll have secure storage at Partner Space A (9am-6pm). Label gear with name + team.

Hana (Eng): Accessibility question: I'm neurodivergent and rely on a quiet desk. Any quiet room options?

Maya (People Ops): Yes 0 we booked two quiet rooms at Betahaus and one at WeWork for that purpose. Mark the RSVP with "quiet room" and we'll reserve.

Noah (People Ops): International teammates: if you're flying in for something scheduled during renovation, reach out for visa/travel paperwork support. We'll convert stipends to your local currency.

TransitBot: Coworking pass created for Hana (Betahaus) on 2026-06-15. Reference: PASS-9876.

Elias (Facilities): If you have permanent items at the hub (plants, whiteboards, monitors), please remove them by Friday 6/11 or label them with "LEAVE". Anything unclaimed after 6/11 will be stored off-site.

Maya (People Ops): RSVP deadline for stipend/room requests: June 1. If you missed it, DM People Ops and we'll do our best.

Hana (Eng): Thanks, that helps. One more: will daily lock-screen badge access still work at the lobby?

Elias (Facilities): Lobby badge works. But temporary access cards for partner spaces will be emailed by People Ops. Carry your company ID.

Noah (People Ops): Catch-all: code of conduct applies at partner sites; if anything goes wrong, report to people-ops@redwood.ai. We'll reimburse reasonable incidental expenses (train, taxi) with receipts.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all 1 — reach out if you need special accommodations. We'll post a follow-up with booking links and the storage map tomorrow. :clipboard:
